summary.intent: Evaluate how well the wisp-plugins set worked for front-end work and design ideation by analyzing ~810 past sessions from the orin-dx and pages projects, then act on the findings by redesigning the plugin set (v5) and resolving review findings on the resulting change.
summary.outcome: Four analysis agents confirmed the plugins were too rigid for exploratory and visual work. A v5 redesign (wisp core, wisp-packs, trimmed muse and courier, eight plugins deleted) was merged on v5-core and pushed as Entire trail #414. Fixes for three review findings on change #6 were committed but not yet pushed or marked resolved.

repo: The orin-dx and pages project dirs hold only a handful of real sessions each; the other ~140 and ~590 files are subagent transcripts, so file counts overstate session counts.
Plugin agents were used in only two top-level sessions (orin-dx b8d16e96 and pages 24655582); smith reviewer/mutator/recon/exit-gate and sentinel agents were never used.
Specs had no way to express visual intent (spec@1 has no tokens, layout or breakpoint fields), so gated specs passed while visual defects such as the NavSheet not being full screen shipped.
Muse docs referenced a ranger accessibility taxonomy that never existed, so implemented accessibility was never checked until a manual audit on 16 Oct.
Pre-commit and exit-gate loops cost many rounds: SPEC-001 needed 13 verdicts, and the orchestrator ignored the 3-retry escalation rule.

Merging the three v5 tracks repeatedly conflicted in harnesses/codex/catalog.json and in both marketplace.json files; generated Codex files must be regenerated with `just marketplace-sync` and `just claude-manifests-sync`, not hand-edited.
Non-interactive `claude -p` needs `allowed-tools: Read` in skill frontmatter to read plugin files; `$ARGUMENTS` and `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` are substituted in skill text.
`just check` is the repo gate and covers tests, manifests, marketplace sync and ADR style, but not `just claude-validate`.

code.finding: Stop hook blocks once asking for a 'Not verified:' line. It fails open, allows the stop when stop_hook_active is set, and keeps a per-session fingerprint of tree state. WISP_STOP_CHECK=off disables it. It was untested in a live session.

SessionStart hook reads `Packs:` lines from AGENTS.md at the cwd, in ancestors up to .git, and up to 4 levels below. It injects each pack once and fails open. A review finding on it was fixed in the last commit.

Retired-pipeline rules (Spec Correction Loop, Persistence, Retry Caller Constraint) were rewritten in terms of wisp:work and wisp:verifier. The agent-embedded constitution block must stay byte-identical across agents.

friction: The initial session count was wrong (~810 'sessions'), because subagent transcripts were counted.
The classifier denied deleting merged remote branches and resolving the Entire findings on trail #386.
Merge conflicts in the catalog and marketplace JSON, including one hand-edit that dropped an opening brace.
The first sweep left the constitution's retired-pipeline rules and introduced stale muse:component references, so a second pass was needed.
Stale old-plugin names remained in several shared docs after the deletion.
The wisp-packs findings pull was too slow, so the agent used a throwaway parallel script instead.
The agent wrote up its report after the fact while one 130KB spec stalled the stream in the analyzed sessions.
open_items: Push the finding-fix commit and mark the three findings on change #6 resolved or dismissed.
Get review and merge for #414, then run `just release` for 5.0.0.
Retry the denied cleanups: delete merged remote branches and resolve the three Entire findings on trail #386.
Smoke-test v5 in a live Claude Code session, covering the Stop hook, wisp:verifier handback and pack injection; Codex and Antigravity are also unverified.
Prepare PRs for Callisto, Caliper, Monokl and Pages to switch from old plugin ids and /guide to wisp, courier, muse and wisp-packs, held until #414 merges.
Pack taste calls: expect/panic, camino and FxHashMap, no any/unknown in TS, and a third house pack for cross-language writing rules.
The UI pack waits on the brand source of truth.
Prune the eight-entry NO_CALLER_YET allowlist of unused shared references.

Design gaps identified but not built: an explore/sketch mode with rendered options, visual-intent criteria in specs, a prototype-to-spec promote path, a decision log, and gate convergence control for wording-only blockers.
Measure whether v5 reduces gate rounds, turns and tokens after a week or two of real use.
